A list of spells available to be learned by the Warlock class upon level up.

Overview

The level column indicates minimum Warlock level needed.

Warlock spells are Known spells and cannot be changed after they are learned through a level up.

Warlock spells will use the caster's Charisma modifier for Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.
